title: When the Rain Came
transcript: My friend Jo and I had planned a picnic by the lake, but it began to rain just as we left home. I wanted to cancel, while Jo suggested looking for somewhere under cover. We found a public shelter in a nearby park. An older couple were already there, playing cards. They moved their bags to make room for us and taught us their game. We shared our sandwiches with them. I remember that afternoon far better than any picnic that went according to plan.

options: Waiting at the lake until it cleared.
questions.explanation: Jo 建议找个能遮雨的地方。

questions.prompt: What did the speaker and Jo share with them?
questions.explanation: 两人把自己带的三明治分享给了他们。
